reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance moderate, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) cheap

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.68% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +3bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+1.1pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 142 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 82 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is moderately priced. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 14.3 sits at the 3th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 10.6, so implied carries +3.7 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: SoftBank draws over $20B of early interest in its $11B+ junk bond deal for OpenAI funding
items.note: Order book has grown to 2x+ the deal size ahead of Thursday pricing, on track to be the biggest non-financial APAC corporate bond ever — SoftBank is loading record junk debt onto its balance sheet specifically to fund its OpenAI commitments.

items.headline: CoreWeave prices upsized $3.7B convertible notes at 2.875% coupon; stock fell on announcement
items.note: Deal was upsized from a $3B target and priced with a coupon roughly 64% higher than CoreWeave's April convertible, a live read on the company's rising cost of capital as its debt load approaches $36B.

items.headline: Sona Asset Management maps $3.6T of AI financing, flags ~120 of 176 deals as 'highly circular'
items.note: Research names Oracle ($125.3B debt + $288B undisclosed data-center leases) and CoreWeave ($35.6B debt) as the most leveraged nodes in a circular Nvidia-OpenAI-cloud financing web where an OpenAI spending slowdown could cascade through suppliers.

items.headline: Oracle's 5-year CDS spread tops 200bps, matching 2008 crisis levels, as critics say BBB- rating is too generous
items.note: S&P's own projections show Oracle free cash flow declining 32% and staying negative through 2027, yet it kept Oracle one notch above junk — a growing gap between rating-agency assessment and market-implied credit risk.

items.headline: CleanSpark's debut junk bond for a Meta-anchored data center prices at 8.25% yield despite 4x oversubscription
items.note: First-ever junk bond backed by a Meta data-center lease cleared at speculative-grade pricing even with heavy demand, a data point on rising financing costs for AI data-center debt generally.
